cards.headline: Direct connection to origin mills and growers
cards.copy: Our sourcing conversations begin directly with registered origin mills and farming estates. By eliminating intermediaries and verifying crop provenance at source, we ensure authentic lot identity, consistent commercial grade specifications, and dependable availability.
specs: Verified harvest provenance and single-estate lot identity
Basmati Rice (1121 Supreme) & Estate Single-Origin Coffee

cards.headline: Scientific testing and laser Sortex grading
cards.copy: Every consignment undergoes rigorous multi-stage quality verification—from grain moisture testing and laser Sortex optical cleaning to ISO-certified laboratory checks and origin phytosanitary documentation before dispatch.
specs: Laser Sortex optical purity cleaning (99.8%+ purity)
Moisture controlled under 11.5% for grains, under 4.5% for dry fruits
Independent SGS & ISO accredited laboratory analysis certificates
cards.subCaption: Moisture testing, Sortex purity analysis & certified lab specs

cards.headline: Coordinated container dispatch to world ports
cards.copy: Whether procuring trial batches (25 MT container) or ongoing multi-container annual supply contracts, our trade desk coordinates custom packaging, deepwater port scheduling, and ocean freight on FOB, CIF, or CFR terms.
specs: FOB, CIF, CFR & EXW quotation terms across all major routes
Heavy-duty barrier packaging from 5 kg retail to 50 kg bulk PP bags
cards.subCaption: Multi-port container shipping to Middle East, Europe, UK & Americas

cards.headline: Clarity and accountability beyond the contract
cards.copy: A dependable wholesale partnership extends far beyond initial pricing. We provide real-time vessel tracking, standardized lot traceability, proactive regulatory compliance, and a dedicated trade specialist for your commercial orders.
specs: Dedicated trade account specialist & fast quotation turnaround
Pre-shipment inspection reports & digital bill of lading tracking
Commercial contract flexibility for spot loads and annual supplies
